facts.fact: Macra says it has established the Cyber Security Emergency Response Team as the hub for receiving, detecting and tracking local and international threats.
Macra's director general says Malawi has a National Cyber Security Strategy.
The article cites the Electronic Transaction and Cyber Security Act of 2016 as the law under which cyber offences are charged.
facts.system: Electronic Transaction and Cyber Security Act 2016

facts.fact: Police charged a Mzuzu man with cyber spamming under Section 91 of the 2016 Act, and arrested Kamlepo Kalua and Bon Kalindo over voice notes said to breach the cyber law.
facts.system: Electronic Transaction and Cyber Security Act 2016

MWI.note: Only says data protection laws are being updated; no law, bill or authority stated.
Names a police cybercrime unit only; no station record system stated.
